description: This file defines the WithMdcEntry interface for managing MDC entries in loggers within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for Akka-based logging utilities.

classes.name: WithMdcEntry
classes.description: Interface for adding and removing MDC entries in loggers, supporting method chaining and multiple overloads for convenience.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds a single MDC entry to the logger, identified by a key and value.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries identified by key-value pairs.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries with three key-value pairs.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries via MdcEntry objects.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

calls: withMdcEntries(CharSequence, CharSequence, CharSequence, CharSequence, CharSequence, CharSequence)
